events.body: My shipment DL-7313 was two pieces. The brown cardboard box of old books turned up yesterday. The other piece, a huge orange and teal patterned kit bag with all my kitesurfing gear in it, did not. Where is it?
DL-7313, two pieces. The recipient reports the carton delivered on 09-12 and the second piece, a large orange and teal patterned kit bag, not delivered. What do you hold on piece 2?

DL-7313: piece 1 (carton) delivered 09-12 on route 6, signed. Piece 2 (holdall) has no scan after the origin export scan on 09-03. Nothing matching the description on our floor or in the overs cage. We have no record of it arriving here. A trace would be for the Parcel trace team.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Marrowby Arc Logistics
events.body: Please open a trace on piece 2 of DL-7313: a large orange and teal patterned kit bag, last scanned at origin export on 09-03. Piece 1 was delivered 09-12. The Destination depot have no record of piece 2 arriving.

The depot have no scan for the kit bag after it left the origin country on 09-03 and have not found it on site. I have asked the Parcel trace team to open a trace. I don't yet know where it is and won't guess.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Marrowby Arc Logistics
events.body: TRC-9267 opened for piece 2 of DL-7313. Origin partner queried; replies usually take 3 to 5 working days. Nothing found yet and nothing ruled out. Any claim would be for the Recovery team after the trace closes, not before.

So let me get this right. A boring brown box of books gets here without a scratch, and the one bag that screams 'expensive' from across a warehouse vanishes. That is not lost. That is stolen, and by somebody who handled it. The delivery note for the box has the driver's name on it: K. Dunmore. I want it in writing from you today that the bag was stolen while in Marrowby Arc's hands. I want to know whether Dunmore or anyone at that depot touched it, and I want the names of everyone who did. I reported it to the police last night, crime reference CR-5672, and the officer told me to get a written statement from the carrier. And if anyone offers me so-much-a-kilo for kit worth more than my car, I will see you in the small claims court as well.
